title: Product retention pair distribution
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite type, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, let $n$ be a natural number, and let $\rho\in[0,1]$. The product retention pair distribution on $\Omega^n\times\Omega^n$ is obtained by drawing $x$ from the product probability distribution with base law $\pi$ on $n$ coordinates, then drawing $y$ from the product noise kernel with base law $\pi$, retention parameter $\rho$, and input $x$, and returning $(x,y)$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
